description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the minute.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> You can invoke [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the minute.

title.zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的端口连接峰值信息
title.en: Query peak port connection information of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-max-conns --resource-group-id default --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
